summary.LABEL: MODEL_FREE_CEILING
summary.method: Near-miss census on V32 (finalized) waited-and-lost rests (terminal_reason RESTING_ORDER_NEVER_RECEIVED_LATER_SELLER_AGGRESSED_PRINT). Rest TRAJECTORY reconstructed from the full decision trace (PLACE/REPRICE target_cents over time); at each seller-aggressed print (prints.jsonl taker_side=='no') the gap = print_price - ACTIVE walked-down rest level. 1c/2c/3c ABOVE = sellers who stopped just short of our resting bid. Implied joint: convert 1c near-miss (fill at rest level) -> game joint if sibling V32-credited, both below close, sum<100.

implied_joint.note: Convert X% of 1c-near-miss legs that complete a joint (sibling V32-credited). 41 baseline, 201 ceiling; the increment is the 1c-residency-reachable slice of the 160-game execution gap.
